instruction: Place an order for my home address as per my Amazon shopping list in SimpleNote. For each item in it, buy me the highest rated product available now. If two products have the same rating, pick the cheaper one.
notes: The shopping list note is found via simple_note.search_notes and read with show_note; its content yields the item lines. The problem models two shopping-list items (consistent with the 13-call reference); for a list with N items replicate the (item, query, product) triple and extend the goal/complete-task accordingly. For each item, amazon.search_products(query=item text) is the lookup; the agent selects the product that is in stock, has the highest rating, breaking ties by lowest price (checking show_product if stock info is not in the search result). amazon.clear_cart is issued before adding so the resulting order contains exactly the listed products with quantity 1 each (cart changes are ignored by the evaluation). The order is placed with the Amazon address named 'Home' and any valid payment card; complete_task takes no answer, its product/address parameters are only task records mirroring the goal. Usernames are the supervisor's email.
